voice: lead with what the reader can now do
no internal names outside Breaking Changes
numbers only when measured: rounded, with the method

entry_shapes.fixes: - Fixed ... (at most 120 characters before the PR link)

breaking: every breaking change needs a 'What to do' line with the replacement and the version it has been available since
security: state the impact and that it is fixed; never how to exploit it
credit external reporters only with their consent
a dependency update is a security entry only if it patches an advisory that affected Tallyboard
lint_checks: sections in order, empty ones omitted
every entry ends with a PR link
every breaking change has a What to do line
banned outside Breaking Changes: endpoint, ops, reducer, slice, jwt-verify
